integrity: Complete all-parameter proof is included. Exact finite tests independently reconstruct the full edge graph and enumerate local Euler routes. Finite checks are not presented as infinite proof. No independent validation or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Nonbinary labelled alphabet q >= 3, span n >= 2; exact Hamming weights one and two, rotation equivalence only. Does not enumerate orbits under reversal or alphabet relabelling, or other weight ranges. The binary count is previously established. One relevant subscription paper was inspected only in abstract and accessible appendix; a differently formulated earlier nonbinary result remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact enumeration of nonbinary two-shell cut-down de Bruijn cycles
